title: Leaderboard entry removed
description: An admin removed a player's leaderboard entry, for example after a cheating investigation. The subject is the leaderboard.

stat_id.description: The stat the leaderboard is defined on.

user_id.description: The account that held the entry.

game_id.description: The game the leaderboard belongs to.

leaderboard_slug.description: Stable per-stat identifier for the leaderboard.

period_started_at.description: Which period the removed entry belongs to.
